system.description: You can worm into someone's head, but you can also remove them entirely without harming them at all. Target a number of creatures equal to [Arcana] within range, infecting them all with a wave of mana. On a failed Magykal Resistance, each target falls soundly asleep, immediately being rendered Unconscious. If the target takes damage while Unconscious, they will wake. While unconscious as a result of this state, they are shown nothing but pleasant dreams that seek to keep them asleep as long as possible and can not be merely shaken awake.
